hypothesis: Filling all six weapon slots early and levelling whatever weapon is offered, with no evolution plan, should beat the one- and two-weapon runs (mean 4:32) if weapons held actually cause survival; a death by Late Blight with a full bar would show that history gap is survival bias.
expected: Filling every weapon slot with no evolution plan was possible before Late Blight, and it did not produce a long run. Six weapons were full by the 6:03 telegraph, Seeker Sprouts stayed 3/8 because nothing was reserved for them, no chest was opened, and 6:07 beat the 4:32 one- and two-weapon mean while landing inside that same band. That is the survival-bias result the hypothesis was looking for: a weak build can hold six weapons at death.
unexpected: Late Blight did 11 damage. Hot oil (140) and sizzle-imps (73) are the sources large enough to erase the full bar seen at 6:03 by 6:07. Colorado Queen and fry-flies did 2 each, so sprouts at 3/8 still walked out of the queen minute when the line did not close on her. The sixth slot was late: one slot was open at 5:00. Tailgate Fries reached 8/8 by 3:04 and never evolved. Level stayed 17, level with the narrower 6:37 death. Spud Sneakers, Sprouting Eyes, and Butter Pat still landed. Health had already recovered from 61/111 at 2:30 to full by The Masher without food detours.
lesson: A serious run should take the negative result and one hazard fact. Do not open weapon slots before Seeker Sprouts is 8 and Overgrowth is opened; a six-weapon ending is what long runs finish with, not a plan for the first six minutes. Through the Late Blight minute the line is a single off-oil, off-puddle heading, because that minute removed a full bar while the boss hit stayed small. Take nothing else from the wide path.

hypothesis: Filling all six weapon slots before any planned evolution, then leveling whatever weapon is offered, will live through Late Blight and past the one- and two-weapon cluster, because every long run in the history is one that ended holding five or six weapons.
expected: A wide build with no evolution plan was supposed to put weapons in every slot and, if weapon count causes survival, live through Late Blight and past the one- and two-weapon cluster (mean 4:32). The survival half failed in the way the first wide run already pointed at: no evolution, a short death. 3:21 is under that 4:32 mean. The queen's own damage was 2 when the bot did not close, the same chip as the 6:07 wide run. Weaponless screens with no reroll still filled passive slots, here with Mash Finisher, GPU, and Bacon Bits.
unexpected: The six-slot condition never happened. The run died at three weapons during Colorado Queen, about three minutes before Late Blight, at level 9 with Seeker Sprouts 3/8. Hot oil was 109 of the damage taken and the queen was 2, so her contact and her circle are not what ended it. At 2:05 Small Fry was on screen and lost to a Frozen Fries level because the standing want listed Frozen Fries and omitted Small Fry. Nothing reached 8, no chest was opened, and Gravy Heart was never owned. Three weapon slots were still empty at 2:30.
lesson: A serious run should take two facts and leave the rest. Opening weapon slots before Seeker Sprouts is 8 failed again, and this time the slots never filled: three weapons, dead at 3:21, earlier than the six-weapon wide death at 6:07. In a boss minute the line is only the oil exit while oil is ticking, because this directive kept a second heading in the same sentence and hot oil did 109 while the queen did 2. Take nothing that puts extra weapons in want before Overgrowth. The stale want that omitted Small Fry is a coach error on any plan: the mark is the pick, so the wanted button has to be named on that consult.

hypothesis: Opening Overgrowth on the normal sprout plan and then taking only Gravy Heart until 5/5, before any Afterburner Fries or Small Fry level, should live past the 15:22 field-rat death because that run already cleared Fryer King with no oil damage on a 111 bar and the 17:20 run's 183 bar is the gap.
expected: Overgrowth on the sprout plan came before Late Blight, at 3:54, and Small Fry and Afterburner Fries never entered the final inventory. The run lived past the 15:22 rat death and past the 18:27 overlap, to 22:10, with field rats absent from the ledger. Fryer King did not end it: hot oil was 3, and the thinner side kept Amusing at 2 and Compost Titan at 41.
unexpected: Gravy Heart never appeared in the inventory, so the 183 bar was not what produced the clear. Want was only that name from 5:00 through 22:10, and all six passive slots were full by 7:02. The bar was 111 at 5:00, 124 at 8:00, and 151 from 14:00, on Lean Lunch 2/5, Big Bowl 5/5, Fertilizer 3/5, Starch Plating 5/5, Thick Skin, and Salt Shaker. The weapon freeze did not hold: Frozen Fries leaked at 0:24, the 2:00 want still named Fry Knives, Permafrost was already evolved at 8:00, and the end set was Permafrost, Gem Sling 8/8, Thousand Fries, Hungry Sprouts, and Hot Potato 5/8. Death came after the goal, at 22:10, standing on a Mandoline attack while that boss closed from 155 to 53. Lifetime damage was led by Harvester 390 and Kraken 322; the last three seconds were Kraken and Mandoline. The same compound exit-plus-thinner-side sentence was used on all 37 consults, including the ticks where the landing timer was already running. Ice imps dealt 53 and Fryer King dealt 91 beside the 3 oil.
lesson: A serious run should copy the clear's timing and row, and drop the exclusive heart want. Overgrowth before Late Blight, thinner-side walking once the ground is clear, and an exit that is the whole line while a circle, a landing timer, oil, or a puddle is up are the movement facts that held. Starch Plating through 5, Big Bowl through 5, Salt Shaker, and the evolutions that actually opened, Permafrost, Thousand Fries, and Hungry Sprouts, are the build facts. Gem Sling and Hot Potato stay legal because this inventory held them. Gravy Heart leaves want once the passive row is full and it is still unowned. The 183 bar was not the gap from 18:27 to 20:00 on this Daily.
